ForwardedHeaders.//: Deployment configuration. Name the reverse proxies or load balancers in front of this API; leaving both empty means forwarded headers are ignored and rate limiting partitions on the connection address. See README 'Running behind a reverse proxy'.

//Sms: Deployment configuration. Both Username and Password must be set outside Development for the Poctgoyercini gateway to be used — see docs/sms-poctgoyercini.md. Either value left blank falls back to the safe placeholder that refuses to send, exactly as if this section were absent.
//Payments: FrontendBaseUrl is where a payer's browser is redirected back to after checkout — a UX convenience only, never trusted as proof of payment. See docs/payments-epoint.md for Epoint's own PublicKey/PrivateKey, which must be set outside Development or the safe placeholder that refuses to send stays active, exactly as if this section were absent.
//Serilog: Production writes structured JSON to stdout rather than a text template, so a log aggregator can query fields (RequestPath, StatusCode, Elapsed, exception details) instead of parsing a line. Development keeps the human-readable default — see appsettings.Development.json.
//AllowedHosts: Deployment configuration. Semicolon-separated hostnames, e.g. "ovcupirim.az;www.ovcupirim.az". Left empty here on purpose: the real hosts are a deployment fact, and a guessed value would silently reject live traffic. Development overrides this with "*".
